kind: Author-operated source review; no live deployment or scientific assessment

review.scope: Independent evidence registration delta: allow registered P001 aliases without the 047 console, still refuse unknown-only selections before folder creation. Review exact change and regression coverage. Existing Drive grant stays at 6ea7566b; this review does not amend that binding or deploy anything. No patient execution, no science interpretation, no new OAuth scopes.
findings: Delta is correct and within charter: registration now proceeds with any nonempty set of EXPECTED aliases, so registered P001 evidence no longer requires the unrecovered 047 console, matching the operator direction that P001 must not depend on 047 acceptance. The archive remains metadata-only (access metadata-only, max_bytes 0) with its size/md5 identity pin enforced regardless of which aliases accompany it; duplicate-alias and trashed refusals are unchanged.

Fail-closed boundary preserved: NO_SUPPORTED_EVIDENCE_SELECTED is raised after local selected-*.json/selected-metadata.json preservation but before allocate_ids/create, so an unknown-only selection can never allocate or create the remote Drive folder or emit config.json/folder-intent.json. folder-intent.json is still written before the remote create, preserving reconciliation/recovery ordering for allocated IDs.

Regression coverage matches the scoped behaviors: test_p001_registration_does_not_require_047_console asserts exactly the four P001 aliases register with the archive still metadata-only/max_bytes 0, and test_unknown_selection_refuses_before_folder_creation patches allocate_ids to fail on invocation and asserts neither config.json nor folder-intent.json exists. Source-only review; tests were not executed.

Deployment precondition (not a code defect, not amended here): DRIVE_ACCESS_APPROVED_20260908.json binds the approved capability to source 6ea7566b. Live registration under this changed source at bef23735 requires the operator to refresh that source binding first; this review flags the gap without altering the grant.

Suggestions (non-blocking): (a) p001-preflight-console max_bytes (32 MiB) is never asserted in tests; (b) a mixed known+unknown selection (exercising the continue path alongside registration) is untested; (c) a nonexistent destination parent raises raw FileNotFoundError from stat() instead of FRESH_PROTECTED_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED; (d) an unknown-only refusal leaves the local destination populated, so a rerun needs a fresh destination — consistent with the never-repeat-partial-setup docstring, but worth stating in operator docs.

deployment: Existing grant/source remains 6ea7566b. Reviewed correction is available if independent P001 registration is needed; exact source binding must be resolved before its deployment.
